About Krishna Yoga Studio

A modern home for an ancient practice

Krishna Yoga Studio was founded by the grace of Krishna and guided by His teaching — Samatvam yoga uchyate, “equanimity is called yoga.” We began with a simple belief: to connect with our roots and live a drugless, healthy, and calm life.

We bring traditional Hatha, Vinyasa, and Pranayama teachings, taught by certified instructors, directly into your home through small, live, interactive classes. No pre-recorded videos. No shortcuts. Just real teachers, real breath work, and a practice built to last a lifetime.

What guides us

Vision, Mission & Philosophy

01

Vision

A world where every person, regardless of geography, has access to authentic, high-quality yoga instruction — and the calm, clarity, and strength it brings.

02

Mission

To heal busy and frustrated minds and help them feel their inner beauty — live, personal, and rooted in real lineage — so students build a sustainable, lifelong practice.

03

Philosophy

Yoga is union — of breath and movement, of body and mind, of self and stillness. We teach the full practice, not just the postures.

Benefits of Yoga

What changes when
you commit to practice

Backed by tradition. Felt within weeks. These are the shifts our students report most.

01

Physical strength & flexibility

Improved mobility, posture, and muscular endurance through consistent, guided practice.

02

Lower stress & anxiety

Breathwork and asana regulate the nervous system, lowering cortisol over time.

03

Sharper mental clarity

Meditation practice builds sustained focus, memory, and decision-making capacity.

04

Deeper, more restful sleep

Evening pranayama and yin sequences calm the body into genuinely restorative sleep.

05

Emotional balance

A steady practice builds resilience, patience, and a calmer relationship with emotion.

06

Lasting inner peace

Beyond the physical — a quieter mind and a steadier sense of self, on and off the mat.

Cultivating Sattva

The quality of clarity, balance, and light

In the yogic tradition, all of existence moves through three qualities — gunas: Tamas (inertia), Rajas (restlessness), and Sattva (clarity). Our practice is designed to steadily shift you toward Sattva.

This isn't abstract theory — it shows up as calmer reactions, cleaner thinking, and a body that feels lighter rather than heavier. We build Sattva through diet awareness, breath discipline, consistent practice timing, and stillness — not through intensity.

See how our programs build it →

FAQs

Questions, answered

Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out — we reply within a day.

Do I need any prior yoga experience?

Not at all. Our beginner programs are designed for complete newcomers, and instructors adapt every class to your level in real time.

What equipment do I need?

Just a yoga mat, a quiet space, and a stable internet connection. We'll send a short equipment guide after you book your trial.

How large are the live classes?

We cap classes to keep them personal — small enough that your instructor can see and correct your form every session.

Can I join if I'm not in India?

Yes — every class runs live over Zoom, so you can join from anywhere in the world with a stable internet connection.

Can I cancel or pause my subscription?

Anytime, no questions asked. Monthly plans can be cancelled before renewal or paused for travel or health reasons, and Samarpan sessions are booked one at a time.
